title: White Bean & Kale Soup
description: A simple, hearty soup of white beans, kale and garlic in a light tomato-vegetable broth.
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic, then add the beans, tomatoes and broth.
Simmer 15 minutes, mashing some of the beans to thicken the soup.
Stir in the kale and cook until wilted, about 5 minutes more.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food healthy eating collection

notes: Mashing a portion of the beans is what gives this body without needing any cream.
